{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing data)
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Compute mean age and count of non-missing ages
mean_age = df['customer_age'].mean()
valid_count = df['customer_age'].count()

# Print both values
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")
print(f"Valid age entries: {valid_count}")"}
